_comment: DRAFT for Anay + Diya to agree on. Returned by Diya's brain.plan(brain_snapshot.json). Hand-written illustration, not computed by the scheduler; routes and travel times match RoadRouter output (T3: 10 cells at 0.5/min = 20 min; T2: 2 cells at 0.6/min = 3.333 min). Anay applies it only if source_state_version still matches and validation.passed is true, then adds plan.version and broadcasts plan -> explanation -> jobs. Internal status (feasible | optimal | timeout | infeasible | unsupported) is mapped by Anay's operation layer; only plan.solver_status uses the public enum. Travel/idle deltas are omitted until both plans are measured with the shared definitions.

_example_unassigned_entry.detail: needs bin_trailer; only T2 has one and it is broken

_example_violation_entry.detail: would end at 7% fuel, reserve is 10%
